title: Factorial expression for a finite product
statement: For natural numbers $m$ and $d$, the product of $(m+i+1)/(m+3d+i+1)$ over $i=0,\ldots,3d-1$ equals $((m+3d)!)^2/((m+6d)!\,m!)$.
